core.summary: Primary ingress, orchestration, and shared auth/session runtime.

password.summary: Stable password flow integrated with core session lifecycle.

magic_link.summary: Stable passwordless and recovery delivery path in core.

policy.summary: Policy is embedded by default at GA while extraction remains optional.
caveats: Standalone extraction is not required in current GA train.
Operator-facing authoring/simulation hardening is in progress.

admin.summary: Admin backend is broad; SPA parity and contract harmonization are still closing.
caveats: Some backend surfaces are ahead of SPA coverage.
Uniform pagination/filter/error contracts are still being finalized.

oauth2.summary: OAuth2/OIDC flows are implemented with remaining protocol-closure items.
caveats: Request URL persistence and subject strategy closure are pending.

social.summary: Provider registry and social flows are functional with remaining hardening.
caveats: Final callback-completion convergence with core auth orchestration is in progress.

sso.summary: SAML connection registry and callback model are present and being hardened.
caveats: Enterprise-grade validation and lifecycle policy closure is in progress.

introspection.summary: Token introspection service exists and depends on OAuth2 token-state alignment.
caveats: Final consistency gates follow OAuth2 token model closure.

proxy.summary: Proxy control-plane and route simulation exist with operator-hardening in progress.
caveats: Policy attachment diagnostics and signed-header operator visibility are still maturing.

mfa.summary: MFA module exists but is not release-hardened for GA support.

passkeys.summary: Passkeys module exists but is not release-hardened for GA support.

cli.summary: CLI gateway module exists but is not GA-scoped for production commitments.
